title: Take about 2 grams of combined EPA and DHA daily.
subtitle: Omega-3 baseline
rationale: Raise omega-3 status toward the range associated with lower cardiovascular and all-cause mortality.

evidence.summary: Pooled cohort data associate higher blood omega-3 with lower mortality; outcome trials are mixed, so the case is strong observational plus mechanism.

sources.label: Blood omega-3 levels and mortality pooled analysis

indications: Oily fish appears in the diet less than twice a week.
Omega-3 index is measured and below 8%.
avoidWhen: Anticoagulant therapy or bleeding disorders unless cleared by a physician.
